description: ArmorCodex lets you read, update, and review the policies that govern how AI coding agents interact with tools, files, and infrastructure. Set rules in natural language ("deny webfetch", "require approval for production database changes"), check current policy state, and register intent plans before tool calls run. Built by ArmorIQ for teams that need governance and audit on AI agent activity.
